useful_discoveries.description: Versioned docs and option history prevent importing newer live manual behavior. Retry-After is present by 7.66.0; num_retries was introduced in 8.9.0, so diagnostic support exists in 8.10.1.

Target implementation also retries host/proxy resolution failures by default and requires opt-in for connection refusal. Candidate says conditions include its listed cases and preserves the default policy, so the non-exhaustive transport summary does not change the consequential policy.

For selected transient HTTP failures, Retry-After can lengthen the existing backoff and can terminate retry scheduling when it would exceed retry-max-time. A success-after-retries acceptance fixture must choose durations/header values that fit the 45-second supervisor budget; an oversized header has a different legitimate terminal oracle. No runtime result is claimed.

fail is a body-suppressing alternative to fail-with-body, with its own authentication warning. The chosen fail-with-body is reasonable because it retains diagnostic body data while publication is separately gated. External status checks are another available approach; the assignment does not require enumerating every alternative.
